sentences.en: I like conversing with my boyfriend under the stars.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和男朋友在星空下聊天。

sentences.en: We conversed until late at night while eating cake and drinking tea.
sentences.zh: 我们边吃蛋糕边喝茶聊到深夜。

sentences.en: I need someone with whom I can converse.
sentences.zh: 我需要有人可以和我聊天。

senses.zh: 逆行，逆向；倒；相反的事物
